verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own Breeze Assistant documents plain-language commands for specific tasks: building reports from a description and planning a campaign from a single goal. Its official MCP server also gives MCP-compatible AI tools read/write access to CRM data, which allows natural-language operation through an external agent. Missing for 10: documentation of general natural-language control across the whole product beyond reporting and campaigns, depth and limits of the assistant's command set, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: with Breeze Assistant, describe the report you need in plain language, and HubSpot will build it from your actual data.
Plan a full campaign from a single goal, in one session
The HubSpot MCP server enables you to give any MCP-compatible AI tool or agent secure read and write access to your HubSpot CRM data — contacts, deals, engagements, and more.
